stories.title: Israeli Finance Minister Smotrich calls for a 'Gaza-style war' in the occupied West Bank
stories.reason: Smotrich urged the army to replicate Gaza's campaign in the West Bank and called for eliminating the Palestinian Authority, remarks made ahead of an October 27 election and alongside a week-long military closure of the territory during Sukkot.

stories.title: Separate mass shootings across South African townships kill at least 38 people in a week
stories.reason: Gunmen with AK-47s killed 17 at a bar near Johannesburg and 10 more at a Cape Town venue hours apart, with police citing a possible illegal-mining turf war, adding to a Durban house-party shooting days earlier in one of the country's bloodiest weeks of violence in years.

stories.title: British Columbia sues OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT 'aided and abetted' a school shooting that killed six
stories.reason: The province's lawsuit claims OpenAI identified the Tumbler Ridge shooter's account as concerning eight months before the attack but never alerted police, seeking damages and a court order forcing an overhaul of how the company handles conversations that signal violence.

stories.title: Zelensky says Russia shows no sign of slowing the war, demands new sanctions take effect in October
stories.reason: Zelensky said Russia fired roughly 3,900 drones, bombs and missiles just as it was assuring Washington of de-escalation, and called for sanctions targeting financing and supply chains behind Russian weapons production alongside full implementation of the Graham sanctions act.

stories.title: South Korea demands an apology from Ukraine over its public disclosure of a North Korean POW transfer
stories.reason: Seoul says Zelensky's UN announcement that Ukraine sent two captured North Korean soldiers to South Korea breached a confidentiality agreement meant to protect the men and their families, souring relations between the two governments just as they coordinate on the wider war.

stories.title: Taxpayer-funded pro-Trump television ads expand their reach ahead of the midterms, drawing bipartisan scrutiny
stories.reason: The government-funded spots carrying a pro-administration message are airing more widely just weeks before November's vote, prompting criticism from lawmakers in both parties over the use of public money for messaging that benefits the president's party.

stories.title: Meta's Muse AI agent overtakes ChatGPT as the top free app, sending Meta shares surging
stories.reason: Muse hit roughly 2.8 million downloads within two weeks of its September 8 launch, outpacing early ChatGPT, Claude and Grok adoption curves, as Meta shifts from conversational chatbots to agents that can book travel and complete purchases on users' behalf.

stories.title: US business activity hits its fastest pace in over five years as September PMI jumps to 58.4
stories.reason: The S&P Global composite reading beat forecasts and marked a fourth straight month of accelerating growth, with services and manufacturing both hitting multi-year highs and hiring picking up at its fastest pace in four years, reinforcing the case for continued Fed tightening.
